name: Nemtly Booking
author: sapayth

sections.description:
Nemtly Booking transforms your WordPress site into a powerful event and appointment booking platform. Built with performance and usability in mind, this plugin provides an intuitive interface for creating events, managing bookings, and handling availability.

Key Features

Event Management

  • Create and manage one-time, recurring, and slot-based events
  • Set dates, times, capacity limits, and pricing
  • Organize events with categories and tags
  • Google Calendar two-way sync

Booking System

  • Seamless booking forms with real-time availability
  • Stripe payments and manual payment recording
  • Booking confirmation and email reminders
  • Customer dashboard with magic link login

Gutenberg Blocks

  • Nemtly Events — A Query Loop variation that displays your events using the native WordPress block editor. Pair it with the Event Date, Event Location, Price, and Booking Trigger inner blocks.
  • Event Calendar — An interactive calendar with month, week, day, and list views. Configurable filters, toolbar, and color coding.
  • Booking Calendar — An inline booking widget for a single event with date picker, time slots, and checkout.

Shortcodes

  • [nemtly_event_list] — Display upcoming events in a grid or list
  • [nemtly_calendar] — Render the interactive event calendar
  • [nemtly_booking_calendar] — Embed a booking calendar for a single event
  • [nemtly_booking_form] — Show the booking form for a specific event
  • [nemtly_booking_dashboard] — Customer dashboard for booking history

Admin Interface

  • Intuitive event, booking, and payment management
  • Setup wizard for first-time configuration
  • Settings organized into clear tabs

Perfect For

  • Event Organizers — Manage workshops, conferences, and meetups
  • Service Providers — Handle appointment bookings for consultations
  • Fitness Studios — Schedule classes and personal training sessions
  • Educational Institutions — Organize courses and training programs
  • Small Businesses — Manage customer appointments and consultations

Why Choose Nemtly Booking

  • Performance Optimized — Fast loading and efficient resource usage
  • SEO Friendly — Clean URLs and proper meta tags
  • Accessibility — WCAG compliant for inclusive user experience

Easy Setup

  1. Install & Activate — Upload and activate the plugin
  2. Run the Setup Wizard — Configure your basic settings
  3. Create Events — Add your first event through the admin panel
  4. Display Events — Use blocks or shortcodes to show events on your site
  5. Start Booking — Your users can now book and pay

Secure & Reliable

  • Built with WordPress security best practices
  • Regular updates and maintenance
  • Data validation and sanitization
  • Secure booking and payment process

Support

  • Support Forum: WordPress.org Support

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Nemtly Booking”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration & Setup Guide

  1. General Setup

    • Navigate to Nemtly Booking in your admin menu
    • Run the Setup Wizard to configure your basic settings
    • Create your first Event and define dates/availability

  2. Payment Gateway Setup (Stripe)

    • Go to Nemtly Booking > Settings > Payments
    • Enable “Stripe” as your payment gateway
    • Enter your Publishable Key, Secret Key, and Webhook Secret from your Stripe Dashboard
    • Save changes to start accepting payments

  3. Customer Dashboard Setup

    • Create a new WordPress Page (e.g., “My Bookings”)
    • Add the shortcode: [nemtly_booking_dashboard]
    • Publish the page
    • Customers can view their booking history via a magic link login

  4. Email Reminders Setup

    • Go to Nemtly Booking > Settings > Emails
    • Enable “Automated Reminders”
    • Configure the reminder timing (e.g., send 24 hours before event)
    • Customize the reminder email template

Using the Nemtly Events Block

The Nemtly Events block is a variation of the core Query Loop block, pre-configured for your events.

  1. In the Block Editor, click + (Add Block) and search for Nemtly Events
  2. Insert it — it comes with a ready-made layout: featured image, event date, price, and title
  3. Use the block toolbar to set order and search filters
  4. The inner blocks (Event Date, Price, Event Location, Booking Trigger) are automatically included — rearrange or remove them as you like
  5. Add Query Pagination and Query No Results blocks inside for pagination and empty states

This block works anywhere the Block Editor is available: posts, pages, templates, and widget areas.

Using the Event Calendar Block

The Event Calendar block displays an interactive calendar with multiple view options.

  1. Add the block by searching for Event Calendar in the inserter
  2. In the block sidebar, configure:
    • Default view — month, week, day, or list
    • Available views — which views visitors can switch between
    • Show toolbar / filters — toggle navigation bar and filter dropdowns
    • First day of week — Sunday or Monday
    • Events per cell — max events shown before a “+N more” link
    • Time format — 12h, 24h, or match your site setting
    • Color by — color-code events by category, event type, or none
    • Height — auto or fixed pixel height

Or use the shortcode: [nemtly_calendar] with the same options as attributes (e.g., [nemtly_calendar view="week" show_filters="false"]).

Using the Booking Calendar Block

The Booking Calendar block embeds a booking widget for a single event — date picker, time slot selection, attendee form, and payment.

  1. Add the block by searching for Booking Calendar in the inserter
  2. Select the event from the block sidebar
  3. The calendar, available slots, and booking form render inline on the page

Or use the shortcode: [nemtly_booking_calendar event_id="123"].

This is ideal for service providers (consultants, therapists, tutors) who want a dedicated booking page for a specific service.

Shortcodes Reference

  • Event List: [nemtly_event_list]

    • Displays upcoming events in a grid or list layout.
    • Parameters:
    • limit — Number of events to show (default: 12)
    • order — Sort order: “ASC” or “DESC” (default: ASC)
    • orderby — Sort by: “event_date”, “title”, or “created” (default: event_date)
    • layout — Display layout: “grid” or “list” (default: grid)
    • show_filters — Show category filters (default: true)
    • show_pagination — Show pagination (default: true)
    • show_search — Show search bar (default: true)

  • Event Calendar: [nemtly_calendar]

    • Renders the interactive event calendar.
    • Parameters:
    • view — Default view: “month”, “week”, “day”, or “list” (default: month)
    • views — Comma-separated list of allowed views (default: month,week,day,list)
    • categories — Comma-separated category IDs to pre-filter
    • tags — Comma-separated tag IDs to pre-filter
    • event_type — Filter by event type slug
    • show_toolbar — Show navigation bar (default: true)
    • show_filters — Show filter dropdowns (default: true)
    • week_starts_on — “sunday” or “monday” (default: sunday)
    • events_per_cell — Max events per day cell (default: 3)
    • time_format — “12h”, “24h”, or “site_default” (default: site_default)
    • show_event_time — Show times on event chips (default: true)
    • show_booking_btn — Show “Book Now” button (default: true)
    • show_past_events — Show past events (default: false)
    • color_by — Color-code by: “category”, “event_type”, or “none” (default: category)
    • height — “auto” or “fixed” (default: auto)
    • height_px — Fixed height in pixels (default: 600)

  • Booking Calendar: [nemtly_booking_calendar event_id="123"]

    • Displays an inline booking calendar for a single event.
    • Parameters:
    • event_id — (Required) The ID of the event to book

  • Booking Form: [nemtly_booking_form event_id="123"]

    • Displays the booking form for a specific event.
    • Parameters:
    • event_id — (Required) The ID of the event to book

  • Customer Dashboard: [nemtly_booking_dashboard]

    • Displays the customer dashboard for viewing booking history.
    • No parameters required.
sections.faq:
What are the minimum requirements?

WordPress 5.8 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher. The plugin works with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Does it work with my theme?

Absolutely. Nemtly Booking is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme and follows WordPress standards.

Can I set up recurring events?

Yes. You can create recurring events with flexible scheduling options, including an availability recurrence pattern for slot-based events.

Can I use it for free events?

Yes, the plugin works for both free and paid events. Pricing is optional per event.

What payment methods are supported?

Stripe (via Payment Element) for online payments, plus manual payment recording for cash, bank transfers, or other offline methods.

Can I display events without the Block Editor?

Yes. Every block has a shortcode equivalent: [nemtly_event_list], [nemtly_calendar], [nemtly_booking_calendar], [nemtly_booking_form], and [nemtly_booking_dashboard].

Does it sync with Google Calendar?

Yes. The plugin supports two-way Google Calendar sync via OAuth2. Set it up once in Settings and your events stay in sync automatically.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0 22-03-2026

New – Interactive event calendar with multi-day spanning & month navigation — your events finally get the visual deserve
New – Booking Calendar block & [nemtly_booking_calendar] shortcode — Block Editor fans and shortcode purists can both eat
New – Events Query Loop block — to show the events you want, where you want
New – Availability recurrence pattern for slot-based events — recurring availability windows that generate themselves like magic
New – Direct event links on the calendar — click an event, land on its page, no detours
New – Google Calendar two-way sync — set it up once, forget it exists, feel smug about your productivity
New – Stripe Payment Element with webhook verification — take money from people who actually want to give it to you
New – Manual payment recording — for the “I’ll pay you at the door” crowd
New – Price field for events — groundbreaking, we know
New – Timezone dropdown from WP site settings — no more “Amrica/New_Yrok” typos
Revamp – Frontend event filtering — faster, more accurate, less “why is that event showing up?”
Improved – Stripe webhook handling — Stripe tells us something happened, and now we actually listen
Fix – Slot-based availability calculations no longer return incorrect results
Fix – Booking time slots persist through checkout — your 2:00 PM pick no longer mysteriously forgets it was 2:00 PM
Fix – Frontend no longer shows events that shouldn’t be visible
Fix – Multi-day events render correctly across calendar cell boundaries

1.2.0

  • New: Stripe payment gateway (cha-ching! take payments without the hassle)
  • New: Gutenberg block for Events List (drag, drop, events anywhere)
  • New: Dedicated payment page in admin (all your money in one happy place)

1.1.0

  • New: Magic Link Login (abracadabra, you’re logged in)
  • New: Automated Email Reminders (so people actually show up)
  • New: Customer Dashboard (where the magic happens)
  • New: Shortcodes [nemtly_event_list], [nemtly_booking_form] & [nemtly_booking_dashboard] (embed all the things!)
  • Improved: Event creation flow is now smoother than butter
  • Fixed: Various bugs that were squashed with a tiny digital hammer

1.0.0

  • Initial release (the beginning of something beautiful)
  • Event creation and management system
  • Booking system
  • Admin interface
